subject: Request: Eligibility discrepancy for additional trial credits (CloudGrove)
messages:
From: Sara Mills <sara@cloudgrove.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Additional trial credits for CloudGrove evaluation

Hi Irene,

Hope you're well — quick one from our engineering team. We're in the middle of a cross-team evaluation and have exhausted the initial demo credits you provided for the 'semantic-search' workload. The team has had to spin up new orgs for separate proof points (search relevance, reranking, embeddings) and the trial pool ran out faster than expected.

Is there a way to get a one-time top-up of 200k tokens so we can finish the benchmark next week? We've already got an internal commitment to move forward if latency targets hold. Happy to provide any logs or an updated mutual action plan.

Thanks — Sara
Sara Mills
Head of Platform
CloudGrove

--
Attachments: none
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Sara Mills <sara@cloudgrove.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Jun 2028 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Additional trial credits for CloudGrove evaluation

Hi Sara — thanks for the note and congrats on the progress. Before I commit to a credit top-up, I need to run a quick eligibility check and confirm there isn't suspect activity (we've seen cases where teams open multiple orgs to stretch trial credits). Looping in Ben (fraud ops) and Neha (policy) to validate.

Ben/Neha — attaching CloudGrove's credit request log from our billing endpoint and a snippet of account activity (redacted). Can you flag any rapid account churn, overlapping invoices, or concurrent orgs under similar billing details? If everything looks normal, we can approve a one-off 200k token grant and draft a short MOU.

Sara — I'll get back to you within the day.

Best,
Irene Choi
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
Attachments:
- credit_requests.csv (stub)
- account_activity.log (stub)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Jun 2028 12:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: Additional trial credits for CloudGrove evaluation

Irene / Neha — I reviewed the artifacts. Quick summary:

- credit_requests.csv shows five distinct top-up requests from three separate org_ids in a 10-day window. Two orgs share near-identical billing contact names/email patterns (sara+eng@ / sara+pilot@) and matching IP ranges during onboarding.
- account_activity.log indicates overlapping sessions between orgs A and B during the same 24-hour windows; token consumption spikes align to scripted bulk evaluations (not a single interactive user).
- No direct evidence of stolen payment methods — billing info differs but uses same root domain and similar DNS records.

My recommendation: flag as "suspected coordinated trial reuse". We should deny an automated top-up. Options: (1) request official PO and move to a paid pilot with a small commitment, (2) if sales wants to proceed faster, require a signed MOU and a one-time discounted pilot fee to cover usage.

If sales decides (2), I can provision a temporary, monitored grant for a limited window and add rate limits/monitoring.

Ben
Ben Carter
Analyst, Fraud Ops | Redwood Inference

On Fri, Jun 14, 2028 at 09:45 AM Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Sara — thanks for the note and congrats on the progress. Before I commit...
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Jun 2028 15:28:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: Additional trial credits for CloudGrove evaluation

Irene / Ben — I concur with Ben's assessment. Additional context from policy: our trial terms allow a one-time extension for genuine single-org evaluations. The pattern here (multiple orgs, scripted spikes, alias emails) triggers our coordinated-usage clause and requires escalation.

Suggested steps:
1) Deny automated credit extension.
2) Offer a paid pilot option with a 30-day monitored grant that includes logging and rate limits; attach the standard pilot MOU (I attached the templated contract excerpt).
3) If CloudGrove signs a short MOU and provides a PO or corporate card, we can provision a 100k token monitored grant immediately to unblock the evaluation while they finalize procurement.

Irene — if you want to keep the customer engaged, propose the paid pilot path in your outbound. If they push, loop legal for contract redlines.

Neha Kapoor
Head of Policy & Compliance | Redwood Inference

> On Fri, Jun 14, 2028 at 12:03 PM Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com> wrote:
> > Irene / Neha — I reviewed the artifacts. Quick summary:...
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Sara Mills <sara@cloudgrove.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Jun 2028 01:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: Additional trial credits for CloudGrove evaluation

Hi Sara — thanks for the fast follow. We dug into your request and found multiple orgs with overlapping usage patterns tied to the same team, which looks like coordinated trial reuse. Because of that, we can't approve the automated 200k token top-up.

That said, we want to keep CloudGrove moving: two options to unblock you quickly:

1) Short paid pilot: a 30-day monitored pilot (100k tokens) at a discounted pilot rate; requires a PO or corporate card on file. I can get this provisioned within 24 hours of receiving the PO.

2) MOU + monitored grant: sign our short MOU (attached) and provide an administrative contact; we'll provision a one-time, rate-limited 100k token grant for a 7-day window while your procurement completes. This includes telemetry and rate limits to prevent reuse.

If you'd like, I can route a draft MOU and a one-line PO template. Sorry for the friction — our policies are there to protect both parties and keep evaluations fair. If you want the pilot path, send the PO to pilots@redwood.com and cc me; if you'd rather discuss, I can schedule 20 minutes Monday with our solutions engineer.

Best,
Irene Choi
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

Attachments: cloudgrove_contract.pdf (stub)
